title: Questions to ask your partner before bed

slides.title: 6 questions to ask your partner *before bed*
slides.sub: Start light, end deep. *The last one always gets them.*

slides.text: What was the best part of your day, and *did I miss it?*
If we could wake up *anywhere* tomorrow, where would it be?
What's something you're *looking forward to* this week?
What's a dream you *haven't told me* about yet?
What's one thing I can do tomorrow to make *your day easier?*
When did you feel *most loved* by me recently?

slides.title: Save this *for tonight.*
slides.sub: Ask one before you fall asleep. Send it to your person if you want them to go first.
